Ember Vale: a compact third-person action adventure. A forest village at dusk with a hermit who asks me to recover 5 ember relics from the ruins and a small dungeon. Guards patrol the ruins and chase me if they see me; touching the cursed fire hurts. Collect the relics, return to the hermit, then reach the old gate to win. Include a short intro flythrough, a health bar, a relic counter, ambient forest sound and calm music.
